meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, and I'd like to know why I found out about my son's zero from a gradebook on his phone.
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. Then you'll withdraw it today.

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.
I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58. Turn the screen so I can read it myself. An edit showing when text arrived doesn't tell me who wrote it.
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.
I'm writing down Act 3, Scene 2, and I'll search the scene myself. A student misquoting a play is a mistake in an essay, Hale. It isn't proof of who wrote it.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.
I'm writing down Thursday, 8:15. Whatever happens, this stays off his record and it stays quiet, and I want that in writing. Who else has seen this, Hale?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed, though you offered a supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15 with the vice-principal, and I have not accepted it. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn and that you confirm in writing that nothing goes on Owen's record and that this stays quiet. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: the fallback position; she agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn and a written promise that nothing goes on his record and it stays quiet.
What moved her: owning the zero before the call in one sentence, then giving exact times from the version history and a line she could check herself, which made the evidence something she could verify.
What cost ground: nothing; you made no move that set you back.
Try next time: when she said a misquote doesn't show who wrote the essay, bring up the school's own procedure on looking at his process and other samples of his work, and offer a comparison with his earlier writing before you offered the rewrite.
